name: fusion-jev
description: Grounded Fusion inspection and bounded Jev choices for coding chats

interface.shortDescription: Grounded code evidence with bounded Jev choices.
interface.longDescription: Try Fusion for repository inspection and source-linked evidence. Jev selects only among bounded prebuilt actions when needed. Codex keeps reasoning, edits, commands, web research and correctness decisions. A local Fusion CLI or private MCP connection supplies the tools.
defaultPrompt: Try Fusion first for grounded repository inspection: fusion_assist for a bounded task, fusion_inspect for known reads, and fusion_evidence for exact bytes or attributed host research. Do not call Jev for obvious reads.

Codex owns reasoning, edits, command choice, permissions, research and correctness. Run chosen commands through fusion-jev run -- program argv...; use RTK/native tools when unavailable or unsupported. Continue in Codex on escalation.
